title: Uniform eventual image bound for ideal-power cohomology
statement: Let A be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], I an ideal of A, f: X -> Spec A a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism], J=I O_X the extended ideal [def-nagata-extended-ideal], and F a coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent]. Fix q >= 0. Let M_n=H^q(X,J^n F) as an A-module by restriction along A -> Gamma(X,O_X), with the image products of [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module] and cohomology of [pqf-def-cohomology]. Suppose i_(k,n): J^k F -> J^n F is any family for n<=k whose composite into F is the inclusion of J^k F. Write mu_(k,n) for the induced A-linear cohomology maps. Then there exists c0 >= 0 such that for every c >= c0 and every n,m >= 0 with n+m >= c, the range of mu_(n+m,n) is contained in I^(m-max(0,c-n)) M_n (natural-number truncated subtraction).

source.place: Lemma 02OA, proof of (1) and (2); independently read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/02OA

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-cohomology-powers-ideal-rees-finite] the sum of M_n is a finite graded Rees(I)-module with the stated scalar-induced products. Monic inclusions into F identify i with the canonical maps and give composition, commutation with products, and transition after a product equal to ordinary scalar multiplication. Apply the cohomology functor.

Replace finite generators by their finitely many homogeneous components. Bound their degrees by c0, taking zero for the empty set. Comparing degree-r components and factoring I^(r-d)=I^(r-c) I^(c-d) gives M_r=B_(r-c) M_c for every r>=c>=c0.

For n>=c, factor the coefficients again to get M_(n+m)=B_m M_n; transition gives image in I^m M_n. For n<c, generate M_(n+m) from M_c with coefficients in I^(n+m-c). Commuting products through M_c -> M_n gives the asserted image bound. Finite sums and truncated subtraction cover the boundary cases.

lean.statement:
theorem cohomology_powers_ideal_image_bound
    (A : Type v) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] {X : Scheme.{v}}
    (I : Ideal A) (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) [IsProper f] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hJ : J = (Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom)).comap f)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F) (q : ℕ)
    (i : ∀ (k n : ℕ), n ≤ k →
      (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι k).2 F ⟶
        Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι n).2 F))
    (hi : ∀ (k n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ k),
      i k n h ≫ Scheme.idealModuleProductι (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι n).2 F =
        Scheme.idealModuleProductι (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι k).2 F) :
    ∃ c0 : ℕ, ∀ c : ℕ, c0 ≤ c →
        (∀ (n m : ℕ), c ≤ n + m →
          LinearMap.range ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
              ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom).map
            ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).map
              (i (n + m) n (Nat.le_add_right n m)))).hom ≤
            I ^ (m - (c - n)) • (⊤ : Submodule A ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
              ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom).obj
                ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).obj
                  (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι n).2 F)))))
